recipe_detailed: Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat. Brown ground beef, breaking it up, until cooked through and any liquid has evaporated, 6–8 min. Drain excess fat.
Push beef to the side. Add thinly shredded cabbage to the pan and stir-fry over high heat 2–3 min until slightly wilted but still with some crunch.
Combine beef and cabbage. Add soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger. Toss everything together over high heat 1–2 min.
Serve over steamed rice. Top with sliced green onion and a drizzle of chili oil if desired.
